name: 86 Chaos 16.0.84 Deletion Permanence Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.84 Deletion Permanence Fix
notes: Schedule Builder now deletes/tombstones every active Firestore shift document represented by one visible shift chip using the same employee/date/time identity used for display deduplication.

Deleted shift chips are verified after deletion and stale local echoes, Auto-Fill state, publish candidates, labor totals, exports, and listener snapshots are prevented from resurrecting confirmed deletes.

System Administrator global employee deletion now removes/deactivates every active workspaceMembers record for the target account before returning success so deleted users cannot reappear in Staff Roster.

Historical schedules, time punches, payroll records, audit logs, Firebase config, Firestore rules, indexes, credentials, employee schedule visibility, and the 16.0.83 admin delete permission fix were preserved.
